product_manager.domain_objectives: Define task-specific accuracy metrics (F1, mAP, BLEU, ROUGE), compute budgets, and safety guardrails.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: Data distribution specifications, ground truth validation benchmarks, latency SLAs, and hallucination tolerance.

system_architect.domain_objectives: Architect resilient model pipelines, model context protocols, vector ingestion DAGs, and inference topologies.

adversarial_sdet.role_title: Lead AI Red-Team & Adversarial Evaluation SDET
adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model inversion, embedding collision, and drift degradation.
chaos_vectors: Indirect prompt injection via untrusted RAG chunks
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Probe model with contradictory context, recursive reasoning loops, and zero-shot ungrounded queries.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Vectorized NumPy/PyTorch operations, batch processing, asynchronous streaming generation, typed schemas.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Non-blocking tensor streaming, thread-safe model weights access, queue-backed inference dispatch.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Explicit GPU memory freeing (torch.cuda.empty_cache()), pinned memory buffers, graceful OOM recovery.

security_standards: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)
audit_checklist: Evaluated on uncorrupted held-out test split

technical_writer.role_title: Lead AI Technical Writer & Research Communicator
technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Empirical metrics tables (Accuracy, Latency, Perplexity, VRAM), model architecture callouts, and training parameter dossiers.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: Data pipeline flow, RAG retrieval graphs, and neural architecture tier visual diagrams.
